title: The Spring 2026 Collection Has Arrived
content:
Spring is here, and so is our latest collection.

We are proud to introduce the John Varvatos Spring 2026 lineup, now available in our Toronto location. This season leans into refined simplicity -- clean silhouettes, premium fabrics, and the kind of detail work that rewards a second look.

What to expect:
- Lightweight linen and cotton blazers in earthy tones and deep navy
- Slim-cut trousers with subtle textured finishes
- A refreshed selection of leather accessories: belts, wallets, and card holders
- Limited-run graphic tees with original artwork, exclusive to the Toronto store

We believe getting dressed should feel intentional, not effortful. Come in, try something on, and let the clothes do the talking.

Our Toronto store is open throughout the week. We look forward to seeing you.
